_readme: Tools from the apps site (PR #8, site.json > apps_url) embedded in articles, right after the worked example. 'calc' tools load as a live calculator through the apps site's embed.js (an iframe that sizes itself); 'link' tools show as a card with a button. Hidden while apps_url is empty. 'articles' maps article slug -> tool key. Write {{embed:<key>}} in an article to place one by hand.

tax-refund.title: Tax refund estimator (2026 tax year)
tax-refund.blurb: Enter your pay, withholding and family, and see whether you're likely to get a refund or owe.

debt-payoff.title: Debt payoff calculator with chart
debt-payoff.blurb: Add your debts and extra payment, and see avalanche and snowball side by side, with a payoff chart and a printable plan.

52-week.title: 52-week savings challenge tracker
52-week.blurb: Save $1 in week 1, $2 in week 2, up to $52: $1,378 in a year. Pick your own goal, tick off each week, and print the chart. Free, and your progress stays in your browser.
